info.title: BAFO Public API
info.summary: ERP integration API of the BAFO competition platform (tenders and auctions).
info.description:
Authenticate every call with `Authorization: Bearer <access_token | api_key>`. Get an access token from `POST /oauth/token` (OAuth2 client credentials), or create an API key (`bafo_{env}_{prefix8}_{secret32}`) in the dashboard. Tokens never go in URLs.

Responses use the envelope `{"data": …, "meta": {…}}`; errors are `{"message", "code", "errors", "details"?}`. `Accept-Language: ar|en` localises messages (default ar).

The organization is the API client's: objects of other organizations answer 404. Competitions are visible to their issuer only.

Lists use cursor pagination (`per_page` ≤ 200, `cursor`) and `updated_since`. POSTs that create or act require an `Idempotency-Key`; a replay returns the original response.

Money is integer halalas (`*_minor`) with `currency: "SAR"`, excluding VAT (15%). Times are RFC 3339 UTC with milliseconds.

Rate limits: 600 GET and 300 other requests per minute per client, 1500 per minute per organization; the token endpoint allows 20 per minute per IP and client_id.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Endpoints, delivery log and the event catalogue.

post.summary: Get an access token (OAuth2 client credentials)
post.description: RFC 6749 client-credentials grant. Send the client credentials with HTTP Basic (`client_id:client_secret`) or in the body. `scope` (space-separated) must be a subset of the client's scopes; all of them when omitted. Tokens last 30 minutes. This is the only response without the `{data}` envelope. Limited to 20 requests per minute per IP and client_id.

post.description: Sets the delivery to pending with next_attempt_at = now; the attempt count is kept. invalid_state_transition (409) unless failed.

Delivered only to the issuer organization's endpoints. Thin payload: GET links.object for the full state. At least once, no global ordering: use sequence per object. Return 2xx within 15 s; redirects are not followed. Retries after 5 s, 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 5 h, 10 h and 14 h (9 attempts); 410 Gone disables the endpoint.

parameters.name: webhook-id
parameters.description: The event id (= body id).

parameters.name: webhook-timestamp
parameters.description: Unix seconds at send time; reject if more than 300 s from now.

parameters.name: webhook-signature
parameters.description: v1,<base64(HMAC-SHA256(base64_decode(secret without whsec_), "{webhook-id}.{webhook-timestamp}.{raw body}"))>; several may be space-separated: accept if any matches (constant-time).

apiKey.description: An API key created in the dashboard. It carries all the client's scopes.

System.name: system
System.description: ERP slug; URL-encode the `:` of custom:<name>.

ExternalId.name: external_id
ExternalId.description: The supplier key in the ERP.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: 8–64 chars [A-Za-z0-9_-], one per intent. Replays return the original response with Idempotent-Replayed: true.

Unauthorized.description: invalid_token: missing, invalid or expired access token or API key.

NotFound.description: not_found: unknown, or not your organization's.

Conflict.description: A business rule refused the request (see `code`).

TooManyRequests.description: too_many_requests: 600 GET / 300 other requests per minute per client, 1500 per minute per organization.

details.description: Machine-readable extras; present only when non-empty.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page.

system.description: ERP slug: sap_s4, sap_ecc, oracle_fusion, oracle_ebs, d365_fo, d365_bc, odoo, netsuite, zoho or custom:<name>.

type.description: supplier, customer, rfq, purchase_requisition, purchase_order, supplier_quotation, …

number.description: Human document number when it differs.

external_refs.description: Replaces the whole list when sent.

VendorUpsert.description: The create body without external_refs: the path supplies the ERP key (type supplier). Fields are replaced; an omitted status or notes keeps its value.

national_address.description: building_number, street, district, postal_code, additional_number, short_address.

start_price_minor.description: Halalas. Tender: ceiling (optional); auction: opening (required). Always disclosed.

reserve_price_minor.description: Halalas; issuer only; never rejects an offer.

PublicCompetition.description: The issuer projection of API.md §2.6 without permissions, viewer_role and live.

direction.description: Tender: the lowest price wins. Auction: the highest.

schedule.description: bidding_opens_at, scheduled_close_at, effective_close_at, hard_stop_at, final_window_starts_at, invitation_cutoff_at, extension_count and the lifecycle stamps (published_at … cancelled_at).

counts.description: invitations, joined, declined, participants_with_offers, offers, comments, attachments.

leading_amount_minor.description: null while sealed and not yet opened, or without offers.

InvitationInput.description: Exactly one of vendor_id, vendor_external or email.

vendor_external.description: Resolved through the vendor supplier ref; unknown → item code vendor_not_found.

CompetitionPatch.description: Any create field allowed in the current status (API.md §1.4); external_refs replaces the list.

current_amount_minor.description: null in a sealed competition before the offers are opened.
